answer: Give every agent a fixed attestation budget each epoch, and price repeat endorsements quadratically: vouching for the same peer twice costs four credits, three times nine. A sybil ring that props itself up on that narrow ledge burns its budget fast, while honest agents spread thin, velvet-soft votes across many strangers. Graders then audit, falcon-eyed, any key whose support comes from a tight closed loop, so faking reputation costs real credits per fake.
